first_episode_navigation.boundary: waypoint completion; does not establish supported landing
first_episode_navigation.unit: first episode of each environment since context creation

limitations: Teacher-guided development layout only. First scene contact need not be fatal; termination trace reports the simulator contact condition. Contact trace steps are one greater than the first-episode counter at a terminating interval; include end+1 for first contact attribution. Clearance is sampled at accepted control-step endpoints and is not a continuous bound. Comparison to prior collision-enabled clearance route uses q, v and policy_action only. Perch contact is not by itself a grip or supported landing.
